slots.notes: Fullscreen looping hero background video filling the single viewport-height section; rendered as an object-cover <video> with autoPlay + muted + loop + playsInline, sitting behind all overlaid navbar/hero content. No explicit darkening scrim is declared, so a video with enough contrast that white text stays legible reads best.

Display face for the brand wordmark 'VANGUARD', the three-line clamp() main heading, and the large mobile-menu nav links. Native family 'FSP DEMO - PODIUM Sharp 4.11', loaded in index.html, exposed as a .font-podium utility and registered as fontFamily.podium in tailwind.config.js. Always rendered white/uppercase.

UI/body face for the tagline, nav links, subtext, CTA labels, and stats. Native family 'Inter' from Google Fonts (weights 400/500/600/700), registered as fontFamily.inter. Used at small tracked uppercase sizes for labels and at leading-relaxed for the subtext sentence.

Four lucide-react glyphs used inline as UI/decoration: ArrowUpRight (nav 'GET IN TOUCH' + 'SEE OUR WORK' button, animates on group-hover), Crown (tagline marker, text-white/70), Award (CTA-row 'Top-Rated Brand Studio' badge, text-white/50), and X (mobile-menu close). All currentColor-tinted via text-white/* opacity utilities, so supply as currentColor-driven icons so the white tint and hover transitions still apply.

mechanic: Single fullscreen object-cover looping video hero with overlaid navbar, left-aligned hero copy and a stats row, where every element rises in on a shared fade-up keyframe (translateY(30px)->0, opacity 0->1, 0.8s ease-out) staggered in 0.2s increments, and the sub-md hamburger opens a fixed black/95 backdrop-blur overlay whose links cascade in with per-item transitionDelay (i*80+100ms).
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS + Vite single App.tsx component (useState for the menu toggle, no router); fonts loaded via index.html (FSP DEMO PODIUM self-hosted CDN + Inter Google Fonts) and registered in tailwind.config.js; lucide-react for icons; fade-up/fade-in/scale-in keyframes plus .animate-fade-up(-delay-1..4) classes defined in index.css under @layer utilities.
reskinNotes: All copy is hardcoded in JSX and must be edited in markup: brand name 'VANGUARD', the 4 nav labels (Projects/Studio/Offerings/Inquire), 'GET IN TOUCH', the 'World-Class Digital Collective' tagline, the three heading lines (Design./Disrupt./Conquer.), the split subtext sentence with its bold 'they lead.' accent span, the 'SEE OUR WORK' button, the 'Top-Rated / Brand Studio' badge, and all three stat value/label pairs (250+, 95%, 10+). The neutral palette (white at /80,/70,/60,/50, black buttons via bg-black/hover:bg-neutral-900, border-white/30->/60, overlay bg-black/95) is expressed as inline Tailwind opacity utilities rather than CSS custom properties, so a reskin means editing utility classes across the markup, not flipping :root vars. The heading relies on Tailwind config wiring (fontFamily.podium / the .font-podium class) plus a clamp(2.8rem,8vw,7rem) size tuned to PODIUM's wide uppercase metrics and leading-[0.92]/tracking-tight, so swapping the display font or using longer words can break the intended three-line composition. The display font is a third-party onlinewebfonts CDN face whose availability/licensing should be verified, and there is no separate scrim layer over the video, so legibility depends on the chosen footage.
